'''Coar Maw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Maw traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] hired him to delay a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] who threatened to interfere with her plans to attack the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Luxury]]''. Maw attempted to distract the agents with an audio recording, then ambushed them on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Biography==
[[File:Starwars livingforce swlfcularin picMain en.jpg|300px|thumb|right|Coar Maw was hired to attack a group of heroes on the planet Cularin.]]
Coar Maw was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Maw worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] through the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]; during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he relocated to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Force Convention" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> While Maw was still a relative newcomer in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], he was hired by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], who contacted the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter via a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] that gave the Dark Jedi the appearance of a scarred [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] female. Muun wanted to prevent the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the system, from interfering with her plans to disrupt a conference that was being held aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Luxury]]'', so she asked Maw to delay them. Maw realized that the holoprojection was not his client's true appearance, but he accepted the assignment anyway, and Muun paid some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|dataries]] into his account.<ref name="Force Convention" />

The Heroes of Cularin were summoned by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] to travel to a [[Jedi enclave (Cularin)|Jedi enclave]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and Maw planned to ambush them while they were on their way there. The bounty hunter tried to distract the agents by playing an audio recording of someone being assaulted, a sound he projected from a device placed in an alley. He then prepared to attack them from atop a stolen [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]], which he hoped would allow him to escape easily.<ref name="Force Convention" />

{{RPG}}
Maw picked out one of the agents to attack first, and began his ambush. He fought against the heroes for a short [[Time/Legends|time]], then put his swoop into gear and sped off across the rooftops of Gardrin. Shortly thereafter, [[Office of Peace and Security]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] arrived at the scene and set off in pursuit of him.<ref name="Force Convention" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Maw was a skilled bounty hunter who followed a code whereby he never revealed information about a contract that he had accepted from an employer. Maw's chest, [[Limb/Legends|arms]], and face were covered in bandages due to a skin condition from which he suffered, leaving him in agonizing pain. However, this agony strengthened his resolve to find his targets, because he spent most of the money he earned from collecting bounties on researching a cure for his ailment.<ref name="Force Convention" />

==Skills and abilities==
Maw was proficient at piloting swoops as well as using heavy [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]].<ref name="Force Convention" /> 

==Equipment==
To protect himself, Maw wore a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], and was armed with a [[N'Gant-Zarvel]] [[9118 heavy carbine]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]], and a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]. He also carried with him a pair of [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], which contained detailed reports on each of the Heroes of Cularin and documentation relating to his Bounty Hunters' Guild membership.<ref name="Force Convention" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Eat pudu.|Coar Maw, if the player characters question him about his employer|<ref name="Force Convention" />}}
Coar Maw was created by [[Matthew Domville]] for ''[[Forces of Cularin: Force Convention|Force Convention]]'', the third scenario in the [[Forces of Cularin trilogy|''Forces of Cularin'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]], a supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. During the scenario, Maw's first name is spelt as both "Caor" and "Coar"; this article assumes that the latter is the correct spelling, because it is used more frequently.<ref name="Force Convention" />

In ''Force Convention'', the actions of the player characters, who [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the Heroes of Cularin, can affect how their encounter with Maw goes. If only one player walks into the alley where Maw has placed the audio recording, the hunter shoots at them with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. However, if more than one player walks into the alley, Maw throws a stun [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] and then shoots at them. Afterward, Maw flees on his swoop and, unless the players are able to destroy the vehicle or have any means of following him, escapes. If the player characters do manage to capture Maw, he refuses to answer any questions and only reveals information about his employer if the players use [[The Force/Legends|Force]] techniques or very intense interrogation methods. In the aftermath of Maw's attack, members of the Office of Peace and Security arrive at the scene and they take custody of Maw if he was captured, or leave in pursuit of him if he escaped. If the OPS do take custody of Maw, the player characters can try to persuade the officers to let them have a few more [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to question the bounty hunter before he is taken away.<ref name="Force Convention" />
